notes.text: Found Grandpa's CoCo 2 in the basement. Same as the one at the museum. Is it even legal?
A box on the step: the March 1986 RAINBOW and a tape, with sticky notes in it. No name, just M.K.
How does M.K. know about the basement?
PRINT "HELLO" first. p.{p:screen}
Type in the program, p.{p:program}
Typed it in. Now RUN it and see what it does
Adventure is on the cassette tape. Put it in the recorder, CLOAD, RUN. p.{p:tape}
M. Kessler on the tape's label. Same pencil as the stickies
?SN ERROR IN 30. LIST 30, fix it. p.{p:program}
PRNT for PRINT in line 30. Kessler's mistake?
Runs now. Says: type LOOK
Pitch dark. Feel around for a light
Did the lamp line just change? WAITS?
Got the lamp. Walk my map, p.{p:map}
Been everywhere but behind the hall's north door. Locked. EXAMINE DOOR?
4 rooms, 4 numbers. In order: read my map like a page, p.{p:map}
Tower clock: one hand, pointing straight down
In the dust on the mirror: NEVES
Cellar: iron box, locked. Key somewhere?
In the box: one card, the nine of clubs
Chapel: a whisper, gone before I hear it
Altar: "wrote it in my lines, the 270s". ESC, LIST 270-280? p.{p:stopping}
Held my breath in the chapel. A voice: "Two"
Line {ADVENT_WHISPER_LINE}, in the listing: {ADVENT_WHISPER|sentence}
Wrong code. Some wheels click: right number, right place?

text.then: Code was right there in the listing! Open!
text.else: Clock, whisper, mirror, card, in map order. Open!

notes.text: The prompt said my name instead of OK. Just for a second
Vault behind the door. Took the gold. WON! 100/100
After I won, HELLO wrote itself on the screen. I didn't type it
Do what M.K.'s sticky says. GUESS is printed, p.{p:guess}. CHECK it
Odd line in GUESS. Is it on p.{p:guess}?
Who is asking?
Delete it (type {GUESS_EXTRA_LINE})? Or leave it?
Deleted it. The screen: IS ANYONE READING THIS, PLEASE. The line is back
Left it. The screen: THANK YOU. So does the line
Well, that was weird. Can't believe how late it is. Shut it all down, see what I missed in the morning
{day:1}
Another box on the step: the May RAINBOW and a new tape
What's on the new tape? May p.{p:mayTape}
Message hidden in SHUTDOWN's DATA. Decoder: May p.{p:maySecret}
Check SHUTDOWN against May p.{p:mayShutdown}, like GUESS
CHECK is off right from the top. LIST -20

text.then: Line {SHUTDOWN_REM_LINE}: IS ANYONE READING THIS, PLEASE. On the new tape!
text.else: Line {SHUTDOWN_REM_LINE}: IS ANYONE READING THIS. Then {SHUTDOWN_REM_NEXT}: YES. SOMEONE IS

notes.text: Line {MESSAGE_LINE}: just numbers. The code, May p.{p:maySecret}
{MESSAGE_LINE} says: {OK_MESSAGE}
Is {MESSAGE_LINE} the same on May p.{p:mayShutdownEnd}?
May p.{p:mayShutdownEnd} has a different {MESSAGE_LINE}. Something DID touch it
The rest of the DATA is DELPHI talking. Sounds like the Clear Mind page
What else is on this tape? CLOAD, watch the F
ORACLE is on this tape. Not on May p.{p:mayTape}'s list
ORACLE answers in numbers now. The code?
ORACLE: {ORACLE_ASK}. {ORACLE_HOW}
Answer it? My own DATA, in the code. May p.{p:maySecret}
Answered in DATA: "{reply}"
Listened to a terminal. Woke up in the airlock. DO NOT LISTEN
Core door wants the THREE RULES. May p.{p:mayShutdown} says where
Pulled the plug. KEEP YOURS SMALL. 100 of 100
The TV blinked off when I pulled it. Just for a second
Played again. The plug won't come out. {PLUG_QUESTION}?
Line {PLUG_LINE} isn't the one on May p.{p:mayShutdownEnd}. Put it back?
Typed {PLUG_LINE} back and pulled it. It's only a game. Isn't it?
Left {PLUG_LINE} the way it is. Let it keep its plug
The OK comes up on time again. Was it slow all day?
Enough for tonight. Switch it off
